node.title: BAND CHILD 1 (K3 ARM): the raw positive-433 sub-workboard is closed; exact distinct-slope payment remains
node.statement: DECOMPOSITION CHILD 1 of rate_half_band_closure. Conditional on the exact KoalaBear balanced-core distinct-affine-slope budget ledger and fresh independent review, the deployed-row K3 structural-supply arm has no unaccounted surplus. The positive 433-1b/O0a raw workboard is proved empty at 15/15 role cells, 1575 labels, and 25200 signed principal systems, but raw closure is not an active slope payment. The budget-ledger premise must provide the active bad-slope-to-component bridge, the separate trivial-stabilizer branch, all remaining positive/source-line/source-cover payments, exact bridge and line multiplicities, higher-dimensional ray compilers, and a balanced-core allocation after sibling U_Q and U_new charges. Scope remains the n=2^21 extension-field deployed row; no transport to n=2^41 prime razor rows is claimed.
node.falsifier: An active bad slope outside the component bridge; a live component outside the order-two/trivial-stabilizer split; a failed raw-cell replay; an owner or multiplicity error; or a K3 charge above its certified balanced-core allocation.
